requirements.title: Vendor Corporate Profile
requirements.text: Vendor shall describe its organization, ownership, years in business, financial stability, and experience delivering comparable solutions.
requirements.rationale: Basic vendor background helps evaluators understand organizational maturity and delivery risk.
requirements.responseInstructions: Provide a concise corporate profile, ownership summary, years in operation, financial stability indicators, and comparable project experience.
requirements.evaluationCriteria: Responses should demonstrate organizational stability and credible experience with similar engagements.
requirements.originalText: Vendor shall describe its organization, ownership, years in business, financial stability, and experience delivering comparable solutions.

requirements.title: Comparable Client References
requirements.text: Vendor shall provide at least three client references for projects of similar scope, size, and complexity.
requirements.rationale: Comparable references help validate delivery performance and customer satisfaction.
requirements.responseInstructions: Provide reference organization name, project summary, dates, scope, and contact information where permitted.
requirements.evaluationCriteria: Preference will be given to references with comparable size, scope, industry, and recency.
requirements.originalText: Vendor shall provide at least three client references for projects of similar scope, size, and complexity.

requirements.title: Project Plan
requirements.text: Vendor shall provide a project plan that identifies major milestones, roles, responsibilities, dependencies, and decision points.
requirements.rationale: A clear project plan establishes delivery expectations and accountability.
requirements.responseInstructions: Include a sample or proposed project plan with milestones, workstreams, responsibilities, dependencies, and governance checkpoints.
requirements.evaluationCriteria: Responses should show a realistic plan aligned to the proposed scope and timeline.
requirements.originalText: Vendor shall provide a project plan that identifies major milestones, roles, responsibilities, dependencies, and decision points.

requirements.title: Timeline Risk Mitigation
requirements.text: Vendor shall identify risks to the proposed timeline and provide mitigation strategies for each risk.
requirements.rationale: Compressed timelines require explicit risk identification and mitigation planning.
requirements.responseInstructions: Describe timeline assumptions, likely risks, mitigation actions, and decisions needed from the buyer.
requirements.evaluationCriteria: Responses should identify realistic risks and actionable mitigations rather than generic project risks.
requirements.originalText: Vendor shall identify risks to the proposed timeline and provide mitigation strategies for each risk.

requirements.title: Configurable Workflows
requirements.text: Solution shall support configurable workflows, user roles, approval steps, and notifications without custom code.
requirements.rationale: Configuration reduces implementation cost and supports future process changes.
requirements.responseInstructions: Describe workflow configuration capabilities, role management, approval routing, and notification options.
requirements.evaluationCriteria: Preference will be given to native configuration capabilities that avoid custom code.
requirements.originalText: Solution shall support configurable workflows, user roles, approval steps, and notifications without custom code.

requirements.title: Responsive Web and Mobile Access
requirements.text: Solution shall provide responsive web access for common user workflows across desktop and mobile browsers.
requirements.rationale: Mobile access may be needed for distributed users and field workflows.
requirements.responseInstructions: Describe supported browsers, mobile workflows, responsive behavior, and any limitations by device type.
requirements.evaluationCriteria: Responses should show that core workflows can be completed on supported mobile browsers.
requirements.originalText: Solution shall provide responsive web access for common user workflows across desktop and mobile browsers.

requirements.title: Data Migration Approach
requirements.text: Vendor shall document how the solution supports migration from existing systems, including mapping, cleansing, validation, and reconciliation activities.
requirements.rationale: Migration planning reduces data quality, cutover, and continuity risks.
requirements.responseInstructions: Describe migration tools, responsibilities, mapping, cleansing, validation, reconciliation, and cutover support.
requirements.evaluationCriteria: Responses should provide a complete migration approach with clear buyer and vendor responsibilities.
requirements.originalText: Vendor shall document how the solution supports migration from existing systems, including mapping, cleansing, validation, and reconciliation activities.

requirements.title: Operational Dashboards
requirements.text: Solution shall support dashboard views for operational metrics, trends, exceptions, and user-defined filters.
requirements.rationale: Dashboards help users monitor operational performance and exceptions.
requirements.responseInstructions: Describe available dashboard capabilities, filtering, configuration, permissions, and example metrics.
requirements.evaluationCriteria: Responses should demonstrate useful dashboards that can be configured for buyer-specific metrics.
requirements.originalText: Solution shall support dashboard views for operational metrics, trends, exceptions, and user-defined filters.

requirements.title: Scheduled Report Delivery
requirements.text: Solution shall support scheduled delivery of reports to authorized users and distribution lists.
requirements.rationale: Scheduled reporting reduces manual effort and keeps stakeholders informed.
requirements.responseInstructions: Describe scheduled report formats, delivery channels, permission controls, and administration features.
requirements.evaluationCriteria: Responses should support controlled report scheduling for authorized users and groups.
requirements.originalText: Solution shall support scheduled delivery of reports to authorized users and distribution lists.

requirements.title: Ad Hoc Analysis
requirements.text: Solution shall support ad hoc reporting or analysis capabilities for authorized power users.
requirements.rationale: Ad hoc analysis lets advanced users answer emerging business questions without waiting for custom reports.
requirements.responseInstructions: Describe ad hoc analysis tools, data access controls, export options, and user skill requirements.
requirements.evaluationCriteria: Responses should balance analytical flexibility with appropriate access and governance controls.
requirements.originalText: Solution shall support ad hoc reporting or analysis capabilities for authorized power users.

requirements.title: Hosting and Recovery Model
requirements.text: Vendor shall describe the proposed hosting model, environments, release process, backup approach, and disaster recovery capabilities.
requirements.rationale: Hosting and recovery details are needed to assess operational resilience.
requirements.responseInstructions: Describe hosting architecture, environments, release management, backups, recovery objectives, and disaster recovery testing.
requirements.evaluationCriteria: Responses should demonstrate reliable operations, defined recovery practices, and appropriate environment controls.
requirements.originalText: Vendor shall describe the proposed hosting model, environments, release process, backup approach, and disaster recovery capabilities.

requirements.title: Documented APIs and Exports
requirements.text: Solution shall provide documented APIs or export mechanisms for data exchange with approved systems.
requirements.rationale: Documented exchange mechanisms reduce integration cost and long-term lock-in.
requirements.responseInstructions: Describe available APIs, export formats, authentication, rate limits, documentation, and support for integration testing.
requirements.evaluationCriteria: Responses should include mature, documented, and supportable data exchange options.
requirements.originalText: Solution shall provide documented APIs or export mechanisms for data exchange with approved systems.

requirements.title: Single Sign-On Integration
requirements.text: Solution shall integrate with the organization's single sign-on provider using SAML 2.0, OpenID Connect, or another mutually agreed standard.
requirements.rationale: Centralized identity reduces access risk and simplifies user lifecycle management.
requirements.responseInstructions: Describe supported SSO standards, configuration steps, identity provider experience, and limitations.
requirements.evaluationCriteria: Preference will be given to native standards-based SSO with documented implementation references.
requirements.originalText: Solution shall integrate with the organization's single sign-on provider using SAML 2.0, OpenID Connect, or another mutually agreed standard.

requirements.title: Integration Error Handling and Monitoring
requirements.text: Vendor shall describe data synchronization options, error handling, monitoring, and retry logic for all proposed integrations.
requirements.rationale: Integration monitoring and recovery controls reduce operational disruption.
requirements.responseInstructions: Describe synchronization patterns, error handling, retries, alerting, monitoring, and administrative visibility.
requirements.evaluationCriteria: Responses should show reliable integration operations and clear error recovery practices.
requirements.originalText: Vendor shall describe data synchronization options, error handling, monitoring, and retry logic for all proposed integrations.

requirements.title: Operating Requirements
requirements.text: Vendor shall identify browser, device, network, and infrastructure requirements needed to operate the proposed solution.
requirements.rationale: Technical prerequisites help the buyer assess readiness and hidden operating costs.
requirements.responseInstructions: List supported browsers, devices, network requirements, infrastructure dependencies, and known limitations.
requirements.evaluationCriteria: Responses should be complete and compatible with the buyer's expected operating environment.
requirements.originalText: Vendor shall identify browser, device, network, and infrastructure requirements needed to operate the proposed solution.

requirements.title: Information Security Overview
requirements.text: Vendor shall provide a current information security overview covering access controls, encryption, vulnerability management, incident response, and employee security training.
requirements.rationale: Security program information is needed to assess baseline vendor risk.
requirements.responseInstructions: Provide a security program overview and supporting documentation where available.
requirements.evaluationCriteria: Responses should show a mature security program with documented controls and governance.
requirements.originalText: Vendor shall provide a current information security overview covering access controls, encryption, vulnerability management, incident response, and employee security training.

requirements.title: Data Encryption
requirements.text: Solution shall encrypt sensitive data in transit and at rest using industry-standard protocols and key management practices.
requirements.rationale: Encryption protects sensitive data from unauthorized access and disclosure.
requirements.responseInstructions: Describe encryption protocols, key management practices, data stores covered, and any exceptions.
requirements.evaluationCriteria: Responses should demonstrate strong encryption coverage for moderate or high sensitivity data.
requirements.originalText: Solution shall encrypt sensitive data in transit and at rest using industry-standard protocols and key management practices.

requirements.title: SOC 2 Assurance
requirements.text: Vendor shall provide recent SOC 2 Type II audit documentation or equivalent third-party assurance materials.
requirements.rationale: Independent assurance helps validate the design and operation of vendor controls.
requirements.responseInstructions: Provide SOC 2 Type II documentation or describe equivalent assurance materials, scope, date, and exceptions.
requirements.evaluationCriteria: Preference will be given to recent independent assurance covering relevant services and controls.
requirements.originalText: Vendor shall provide recent SOC 2 Type II audit documentation or equivalent third-party assurance materials.

requirements.title: HIPAA Safeguards
requirements.text: Vendor shall describe how the solution supports HIPAA administrative, physical, and technical safeguard obligations, including Business Associate Agreement expectations where applicable.
requirements.rationale: HIPAA applicability requires explicit evidence of safeguard support and contracting expectations.
requirements.responseInstructions: Describe HIPAA safeguards, covered responsibilities, BAA terms, audit evidence, and implementation assumptions.
requirements.evaluationCriteria: Responses should clearly address HIPAA safeguard obligations and BAA readiness.
requirements.originalText: Vendor shall describe how the solution supports HIPAA administrative, physical, and technical safeguard obligations, including Business Associate Agreement expectations where applicable.

requirements.title: PCI DSS Scope and Controls
requirements.text: Vendor shall describe PCI DSS scope, segmentation, cardholder data handling, and evidence available to validate payment security controls.
requirements.rationale: Payment-related scope requires clear responsibility boundaries and control evidence.
requirements.responseInstructions: Describe PCI DSS scope, cardholder data flows, segmentation, attestations, and buyer responsibilities.
requirements.evaluationCriteria: Responses should clearly minimize buyer PCI scope and provide credible control evidence.
requirements.originalText: Vendor shall describe PCI DSS scope, segmentation, cardholder data handling, and evidence available to validate payment security controls.

requirements.title: GDPR Privacy Support
requirements.text: Vendor shall describe GDPR support, including data subject request workflows, retention controls, subprocessors, and cross-border transfer mechanisms.
requirements.rationale: Privacy requirements need operational support for data subject rights and processor obligations.
requirements.responseInstructions: Describe GDPR-related workflows, retention controls, subprocessors, transfer mechanisms, and contract terms.
requirements.evaluationCriteria: Responses should demonstrate practical privacy support and transparent subprocessor practices.
requirements.originalText: Vendor shall describe GDPR support, including data subject request workflows, retention controls, subprocessors, and cross-border transfer mechanisms.

requirements.title: FedRAMP Authorization
requirements.text: Vendor shall describe FedRAMP authorization status, target impact level, boundary, and continuous monitoring responsibilities.
requirements.rationale: Federal cloud requirements depend on authorization status, boundary, and monitoring obligations.
requirements.responseInstructions: Describe current authorization status, impact level, package availability, boundary, and continuous monitoring responsibilities.
requirements.evaluationCriteria: Responses should align authorization status and boundary to the buyer's federal compliance needs.
requirements.originalText: Vendor shall describe FedRAMP authorization status, target impact level, boundary, and continuous monitoring responsibilities.

requirements.title: Implementation Methodology
requirements.text: Vendor shall provide an implementation methodology that includes kickoff, discovery, configuration, testing, launch readiness, go-live, and stabilization activities.
requirements.rationale: A defined methodology helps evaluators understand how the vendor will manage delivery from kickoff through stabilization.
requirements.responseInstructions: Describe the implementation phases, deliverables, buyer responsibilities, acceptance points, and stabilization support.
requirements.evaluationCriteria: Responses should show a complete and repeatable implementation approach.
requirements.originalText: Vendor shall provide an implementation methodology that includes kickoff, discovery, configuration, testing, launch readiness, go-live, and stabilization activities.

requirements.title: Training Plan
requirements.text: Vendor shall provide a training plan for administrators, end users, and support staff, including materials, delivery format, and completion tracking.
requirements.rationale: Training planning supports adoption and operational readiness.
requirements.responseInstructions: Describe training audiences, curriculum, materials, delivery format, schedule, and completion tracking.
requirements.evaluationCriteria: Responses should include role-based training that supports administrator and end-user readiness.
requirements.originalText: Vendor shall provide a training plan for administrators, end users, and support staff, including materials, delivery format, and completion tracking.

requirements.title: Change Management Approach
requirements.text: Vendor shall provide a change management approach covering stakeholder communications, readiness activities, adoption measurement, and resistance management.
requirements.rationale: Change management helps reduce adoption risk and operational disruption.
requirements.responseInstructions: Describe communication planning, stakeholder readiness, adoption measurement, and resistance management practices.
requirements.evaluationCriteria: Responses should show practical change management activities tied to implementation outcomes.
requirements.originalText: Vendor shall provide a change management approach covering stakeholder communications, readiness activities, adoption measurement, and resistance management.

requirements.title: Phased Rollout Planning
requirements.text: Vendor shall describe how phased rollout planning will be handled across pilot groups, locations, business units, or user cohorts.
requirements.rationale: Phased rollout planning reduces risk for larger or more complex deployments.
requirements.responseInstructions: Describe pilot planning, rollout sequencing, readiness criteria, communications, and support during rollout waves.
requirements.evaluationCriteria: Responses should provide a credible rollout approach for larger user populations or phased adoption.
requirements.originalText: Vendor shall describe how phased rollout planning will be handled across pilot groups, locations, business units, or user cohorts.

requirements.title: Support Channels and Service Levels
requirements.text: Vendor shall provide support channels, hours of operation, escalation paths, severity definitions, and response time commitments.
requirements.rationale: Support details are needed to assess operational readiness and service expectations.
requirements.responseInstructions: Describe support channels, coverage hours, severity definitions, escalation paths, and response targets.
requirements.evaluationCriteria: Responses should provide clear service commitments aligned to production support needs.
requirements.originalText: Vendor shall provide support channels, hours of operation, escalation paths, severity definitions, and response time commitments.

requirements.title: 24x7 Critical Incident Support
requirements.text: Vendor shall provide 24x7 support coverage for critical production incidents.
requirements.rationale: Critical systems may require continuous coverage to reduce business disruption.
requirements.responseInstructions: Describe 24x7 coverage, severity criteria, escalation procedures, and staffing model.
requirements.evaluationCriteria: Responses should demonstrate reliable round-the-clock support for critical incidents.
requirements.originalText: Vendor shall provide 24x7 support coverage for critical production incidents.

requirements.title: Extended Hours Support
requirements.text: Vendor shall provide extended support coverage for production issues outside standard business hours.
requirements.rationale: Extended coverage may be needed for operations that run beyond standard business hours.
requirements.responseInstructions: Describe extended coverage windows, channels, escalation process, and response commitments.
requirements.evaluationCriteria: Responses should align coverage windows to expected operational needs.
requirements.originalText: Vendor shall provide extended support coverage for production issues outside standard business hours.

requirements.title: Complete Pricing Proposal
requirements.text: Vendor shall provide a complete pricing proposal covering implementation fees, recurring fees, usage-based charges, optional services, third-party costs, and assumptions.
requirements.rationale: Complete pricing is needed to compare total cost and identify hidden assumptions.
requirements.responseInstructions: Provide itemized pricing for implementation, recurring fees, usage-based charges, optional services, third-party costs, and assumptions.
requirements.evaluationCriteria: Responses should be complete, transparent, and comparable across vendors.
requirements.originalText: Vendor shall provide a complete pricing proposal covering implementation fees, recurring fees, usage-based charges, optional services, third-party costs, and assumptions.

requirements.title: Pricing Levers and Renewal Impacts
requirements.text: Vendor shall identify pricing levers, discount assumptions, renewal terms, and cost impacts for changes in user volume or transaction volume.
requirements.rationale: Pricing levers help the buyer understand future cost exposure and negotiation options.
requirements.responseInstructions: Describe volume tiers, discount assumptions, renewal terms, usage drivers, and cost impacts for volume changes.
requirements.evaluationCriteria: Responses should make future cost drivers and renewal exposure clear.
requirements.originalText: Vendor shall identify pricing levers, discount assumptions, renewal terms, and cost impacts for changes in user volume or transaction volume.

requirements.title: Requirement Response Matrix
requirements.text: Vendor responses shall include a requirement-by-requirement response indicating whether each requirement is met, partially met, not met, or requires customization.
requirements.rationale: Structured responses make vendor comparison and evaluation traceable.
requirements.responseInstructions: Provide a response matrix with compliance status, explanation, assumptions, and customization notes for each requirement.
requirements.evaluationCriteria: Responses should be complete, consistent, and easy to compare across vendors.
requirements.originalText: Vendor responses shall include a requirement-by-requirement response indicating whether each requirement is met, partially met, not met, or requires customization.

requirements.title: Product Roadmap Summary
requirements.text: Vendor shall provide a product roadmap summary identifying planned enhancements relevant to the requested capabilities.
requirements.rationale: Roadmap visibility helps evaluators understand product direction and future fit.
requirements.responseInstructions: Summarize planned enhancements, expected timing, roadmap confidence, and relevance to the requested capabilities.
requirements.evaluationCriteria: Responses should provide credible roadmap information without relying on speculative capabilities for core requirements.
requirements.originalText: Vendor shall provide a product roadmap summary identifying planned enhancements relevant to the requested capabilities.

requirements.title: Implementation Team Capacity
requirements.text: Vendor shall describe the named team, capacity, and availability of implementation resources proposed for this engagement.
requirements.rationale: Team capacity is important when implementation speed or resource availability is a procurement priority.
requirements.responseInstructions: Describe proposed roles, named resources where available, availability, competing commitments, and escalation coverage.
requirements.evaluationCriteria: Responses should demonstrate enough qualified capacity to meet the proposed timeline.
requirements.originalText: Vendor shall describe the named team, capacity, and availability of implementation resources proposed for this engagement.
